## Description

Trains deep neural networks using adversarial domain-invariant feature learning to ensure cross-sectional momentum trading rules generalize across disparate market environments.

## Where it may fit

Cross-market regime shifts, emerging market expansion, shifting international equity correlations.

## Vehicles

Systematic global equity funds, cross-border CTA funds.

## Required data

Multi-country equity price series, fundamental metrics, macroeconomic feature panels.

## Caveats

Adversarial training instability requires careful hyperparameter tuning of domain classifier penalty weights.
